answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gyorin Formation for 2 energy, gaining 10 Block and setting 6 Block for the start of my next turn. The Sludge Spinner's telegraphed 8 damage attack is fully blocked, so I remain at 48 HP and the enemy remains at 34 HP.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered All Streams Flow to the Sea followed by Coral Guard: 9 damage and 5 Block, taking 3 damage but reducing the enemy to 25 HP. I rejected it because Gyorin Formation avoids all 8 damage and adds 6 Block next turn.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up immediate damage and Hydro applications: the enemy stays at 34 instead of 25, or 19 if I had played both damage cards, and both energy go to defense rather than pressure.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If the intent had been a non-attack such as Defend or a buff, the 10 Block would be less valuable and I would have leaned toward damage, likely All Streams Flow to the Sea plus Water's Edge or All Streams Flow to the Sea plus Coral Guard. A larger attack would have made Gyorin Formation even more attractive.
